nodes.description: Oracle.token0 - address of pair token0, used to decide which TWAP is quoted
Oracle.token1 - address of pair token1
Oracle.pair - IUniswapV2Pair instance used for external cumulative price and reserve reads
Oracle.blockTimestampLast - uint32 timestamp of the last successful oracle update
Oracle.price0CumulativeLast - last stored cumulative price for token0
Oracle.price1CumulativeLast - last stored cumulative price for token1
Oracle.price0Average - uq112x112 TWAP returned to price consumers for token0
Oracle.price1Average - uq112x112 TWAP returned to price consumers for token1
Epoch.period - epoch length in seconds, mutable by the operator
Epoch.startTime - schedule origin for epoch computation
Epoch.lastExecutedAt - timestamp of the last executed epoch
Ownable._owner - privileged owner account controlling ownership functions
Operator._operator - privileged operator account controlling epoch parameters
Oracle constructor: derives the pair, caches tokens, cumulative prices, reserves and requires non-zero liquidity
update() external checkEpoch - recomputes TWAP averages and persists cumulative price snapshots
consult(address,uint256) view - prices an amount using the stored average for token0/token1
expectedPrice(address,uint256) view - computes a hypothetical average from live cumulative prices without persisting state
pairFor(address,address,address) pure - external wrapper around UniswapV2Library.pairFor
Epoch constructor: validates start time and initialises period/startTime/lastExecutedAt
checkEpoch modifier - time based gate requiring now > startTime and callable(), then stamping lastExecutedAt
checkStartTime modifier - requires now >= startTime
callable() view - returns whether the current epoch is at or beyond the next epoch
getLastEpoch() view - derives the last executed epoch index
getCurrentEpoch() view - derives the current epoch index from Math.max(startTime, block.timestamp)
getNextEpoch() view - next epoch index after the last executed one
nextEpochPoint() view - absolute timestamp of the next epoch
getPeriod() view - returns the epoch period
getStartTime() view - returns the epoch start time
setPeriod(uint256) external onlyOperator - mutates the epoch period
onlyOwner modifier - compares _owner to _msgSender()
onlyOperator modifier - compares _operator to msg.sender
transferOperator(address) public onlyOwner - owner controlled operator rotation entry point
_transferOperator(address) internal - validates and writes the new operator
UniswapV2OracleLibrary.currentCumulativePrices - external reads of price0/1CumulativeLast, getReserves and a time weighted top-up
UniswapV2Library.pairFor - CREATE2 address derivation for a Uniswap pair
msg.sender - caller identity used by onlyOwner/onlyOperator authorization checks
block.timestamp - miner/validator influenced time source driving epoch gating and price windows
Unauthenticated oracle state mutation: update() is guarded only by the time based checkEpoch modifier, so any account can rewrite price0Average/price1Average and cumulative snapshots once per epoch
Unchecked division by timeElapsed inside expectedPrice() (no zero guard, unlike update()) causing revert / arithmetic failure
Price exposure surface: consult()/expectedPrice() hand out pricing data derived from a single fixed window that consumers may treat as manipulation resistant
token parameter of consult/expectedPrice selecting token0 or token1 pricing branch
amountIn parameter scaled by the stored average price
pair parameter of currentCumulativePrices used for external calls
newOperator_ parameter written into _operator by _transferOperator
_period parameter written into Epoch.period by setPeriod
timeElapsed local in update() derived from blockTimestamp - blockTimestampLast
blockTimestamp local in update() returned by currentCumulativePrices
price0Cumulative local in update() fetched from the pair
price1Cumulative local in update() fetched from the pair
timeElapsed local in expectedPrice() used as an unchecked divisor
